title: Scissortail Boathouse
specs: All riders must sign a waiver; riders age 15 and younger must have a parent or guardian co-sign
Riders must be at least 36 inches tall; no lap riders allowed
Riders age 12 and younger must be accompanied by an adult
At least one rider must be able to pedal the boat sufficiently
Guests should be in good health; not recommended for pregnant guests or those with heart, neck, back conditions, or prone to motion sickness
Guests must be able to sit upright and keep limbs inside the boat at all times
Up to 4 passengers per pedal boat (max total weight 564 pounds)
Up to 3 passengers per canoe (max total weight 720 pounds)
Single rider kayaks (max total weight 300 pounds)
Up to 2 passengers per kayak (max total weight 400 pounds)

includes: Life jackets required for all riders
blurb: Guests can rent individual pedal boats, canoes, and kayaks to paddle on the lake. Pedal boats are powered by foot pedals and steered with a tiller; canoes and kayaks use hand-held paddles. Life jackets are required and no lifeguard is on duty.
extraNote: No food or drink allowed in boats except water · No standing up in boats · No swimming or fishing except during promoted events · Boats not allowed in upper wetlands area · No animals except service animals allowed in boats; service animals must have life vests · No lifeguard on duty · Next to the Lake and the western end of the bridge at Scissortail Park · Opening March 7
